summary: Acer Aspire 5 14 (Model: A514-54G-57AQ) with Intel Core i5-10300H processor, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 graphics, 8GB DDR4 RAM, and 512GB NVMe SSD. The system is prone to thermal throttling due to inadequate cooling, but can be mitigated with a cooling pad or external fan, adjusting power settings in the BIOS, or monitoring temperatures.
detected_fault: Inadequate cooling system leading to thermal throttling
suggested_solution: Use a cooling pad or external fan, adjust power settings in the BIOS, or monitor temperatures
